props.name: timeout
props.description: Default time before a toast closes by itself, in ms; 0 never.

props.name: limit
props.description: How many toasts show at once. Older ones stay in the list as `limited` (inert, `data-limited`).

props.name: toastManager
props.description: A manager app code can reach from outside the tree. Read once.

parts.name: ToastViewport
parts.description: The live region the toasts are rendered in, spread on the element that holds them. It is a `popover="manual"` shown while mounted: the top layer, with no portal. Being a popover it gets the browser's popover styles (centred, bordered), so give it a position, and `pointer-events: none` where it is empty if it covers the page. Hovering it or moving keyboard focus into it expands the stack and stops the timers. F6 moves focus to it while there are toasts; F6 again goes back. `--toast-frontmost-height` is the newest toast's height.

parts.name: ToastRoot
parts.description: One toast. It closes after its timeout, on Escape while focus is in it, and when swiped past the threshold. While dragged it carries `data-swiping` and `--toast-swipe-movement-x`/`-y`; `--toast-index`, `--toast-offset-y` and `--toast-height` place it in the stack. Animate it in with `@starting-style`; while it closes it has `data-ending-style`, and it leaves the list when its animations have finished.

props.name: swipeDirection
props.description: Where a swipe dismisses it. `[]` turns swiping off.

props.name: swipeThreshold
props.description: How far a swipe must travel to dismiss, in px.

dataAttributes.name: data-ending-style
dataAttributes.description: Present while the part animates out.

dataAttributes.name: data-swipe-direction
dataAttributes.description: The direction it can be swiped away in.

dataAttributes.name: data-swiping
dataAttributes.description: Present while the part is being dragged.

parts.name: ToastContent
parts.description: Holds a toast's text and buttons. `data-behind` is on every toast but the frontmost.

parts.name: ToastTitle
parts.description: The toast's title: its children, or else the `title` it was added with. Renders nothing when it has neither.

parts.name: ToastDescription
parts.description: The toast's description: its children, or else the `description` it was added with.

parts.name: ToastAction
parts.description: A button for the toast's action. Takes the toast's `actionProps` (their `children` as its label) and its own; renders nothing without a label.
